subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: 3D objects and position
source.subtopic: Range of 3D objects: boxes, balls, cylinders

show.line: A box, a ball and a cylinder. A cylinder is like a tin. Flat ends and a round side!

rounds.praise: Yes! A tin is a cylinder.

rounds.prompt: Which object can roll but never slide?
Box, ball or cylinder? Put each object in its group.
Does a box have flat sides or round sides? Say flat or round.
Which object has flat sides and slides?
rounds.praise: Yes! A brick is a box. It slides.

rounds.prompt: Which object has two flat ends and one round side?
rounds.praise: Yes! A candle is a cylinder.

hints: Round sides roll. Flat sides slide.
A cylinder has a round side and flat ends, like a tin.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this object.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A tin has flat ends. It is a cylinder.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Flat ends, round side. That is a cylinder!

parent_line: Can tell boxes, balls and cylinders apart and say how they move.
